verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a payments flow that settles USD to your bank account and lets you reconcile transactions. A List Transfers API with filtering and paging supports polling for reconciliation, and fiat rails (Fedwire, SWIFT, CUBIX) are documented. The evidence never gives payment-to-available-balance timing or a published fee schedule per rail, and shows no accounting-ready statements or report exports; the PYUSD "near-instant, low to no-cost" line is marketing about the stablecoin, not the settlement rails. Missing for 10: documented settlement timing per rail, published per-rail fees, downloadable statements/accounting reports, independent corroboration.
